question: Show the details of rooms including the full name of the rooms, the building names, floor numbers, the organizations occupying them, name of the departments occupying them, and the percentage of the room area over the floor area and building.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "rooms_with_orgs" AS SELECT "fclt_room_key" AS "fclt_room_key", "fclt_building_key" AS "fclt_building_key", "fclt_floor_key" AS "fclt_floor_key", "room_full_name" AS "room_full_name", "room" AS "room", "floor" AS "floor", "area" AS "area", "organization_name" AS "organization_name", "minor_organization" AS "minor_organization", "dept_code" AS "dept_code" FROM beaver."fclt_rooms";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "floors" AS SELECT "fclt_floor_key" AS "fclt_floor_key", "fclt_building_key" AS "fclt_building_key", "floor" AS "floor", "assignable_area" AS "assignable_area" FROM beaver."fclt_floor";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "buildings" AS SELECT "fclt_building_key" AS "fclt_building_key", "building_name_long" AS "building_name_long", "assignable_area" AS "assignable_area" FROM beaver."fclt_building";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH rooms AS (
  SELECT 
    r.fclt_room_key,
    r.fclt_building_key,
    r.fclt_floor_key,
    r.room_full_name,
    r.room,
    r.floor,
    r.area AS room_area,
    r.organization_name,
    r.minor_organization,
    r.dept_code
  FROM rooms_with_orgs r
), floors AS (
  SELECT 
    f.fclt_floor_key,
    f.fclt_building_key,
    f.floor,
    f.assignable_area AS floor_assignable_area
  FROM floors f
), bldgs AS (
  SELECT 
    b.fclt_building_key,
    b.building_name_long,
    b.assignable_area AS bldg_assignable_area
  FROM buildings b
)
SELECT 
  b.building_name_long AS building_name,
  rooms.floor,
  rooms.room_full_name,
  rooms.room AS room_number,
  rooms.organization_name AS organization,
  rooms.minor_organization AS department,
  rooms.room_area,
  floors.floor_assignable_area,
  b.bldg_assignable_area,
  CASE WHEN floors.floor_assignable_area > 0 THEN rooms.room_area / floors.floor_assignable_area * 100 ELSE NULL END AS pct_of_floor_area,
  CASE WHEN b.bldg_assignable_area > 0 THEN rooms.room_area / b.bldg_assignable_area * 100 ELSE NULL END AS pct_of_building_area
FROM rooms
JOIN floors ON rooms.fclt_floor_key = floors.fclt_floor_key
JOIN bldgs  ON rooms.fclt_building_key = bldgs.fclt_building_key
WHERE rooms.room_area IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY b.building_name_long, rooms.floor, rooms.room
LIMIT 100
